name: Jordan R.
story: My car wouldn't start in a grocery store parking lot last Tuesday, right as a cold front rolled in. I was trying to figure out who to call when a guy a few spots over — total stranger — walked over, popped his hood, and jumped my battery without me even asking. Took him five minutes. He waved off a thank-you and said "pay it forward sometime," and drove off before I even got his name. It wasn't a huge thing, but it reminded me how many people are just quietly decent when you're not looking for it.
